v3-5.candidate: The Lord appeared to Solomon in sleep at night. The Lord said to Solomon, “Make a request for yourself.”
v3-5.close: The Lord appeared to Solomon in sleep at night. The Lord said to Solomon, “Ask a request for yourself.”

v3-15.candidate: Solomon awoke: behold, it was a dream. He rose and came to Jerusalem, and stood before the altar that was before the ark of the Lord’s covenant in Zion. He offered whole burnt offerings and peace offerings, and made a great feast for himself and all his attendants.

v3-21.candidate: I rose in the morning to nurse my son, and that child was dead. Behold, I looked carefully at him in the morning, and behold, he was not my son whom I had borne.”

v3-27.candidate: The king answered, “Give the child to the woman who said, ‘Give it to her, and you must not put him to death.’ She is his mother.”
